bm_keeper.text: Gibbs Hill was lit in 1846. Cast iron, shipped out in pieces. The light's up at about a hundred and ten metres above sea level.
A hundred and eighty-odd steps to the top. I've counted. I've been counting for years. I always get a different number.
When the weather turns bad, you can see the weather coming on the sea like a dark wall. Then you go and put the kettle on.

bm_climber.text: Nobody told me about the steps.
Lovely view, though. I'm told. I've had my eyes shut since about step ninety.
